description:
Snow Terrain Bike**How to Assemble Your Taurus Electric Bike**
https://youtu.be/hcnPfBQ-Qjo

Up to 115 KM Long Range - This electric mountain bike can reach up to 103-115 KM (64-72 Miles) under Pedal Assist Mode or up to 56-64 KM (35-40 Miles) under Pure Electric Mode. 2 Ways of Charging: 1. Charge the e-bike directly. 2. Unlock the battery and charge it at home.

Electric Mountain Bike - A rated 500W peak 800W brushless motor can deal with snowfiled, mountains, forests, desert, streams with ease. You can reach max speed to 32 KM/H (20 MPH). The 7-speed Shifter ensure a smooth and comfortable power transmission. Tips: Choose big gear(Shifter 1-3) on smooth road, choose small gear(Shifter 4-7) on rough road.

Electric Snow Bicycle - Extra wide 26"*4.0" shock-absorbing air tires perform very well on both snowfield and rough surface. High elastic lockable fork suspension, ergonomic seat with both spring shock absorber and air cushion shock absorber, keep you comfortable even after long-distance jounery. Max load is 120 KG (265 lbs).

Safe to Ride - A 5-level LCD display in the middle of the handlebar makes it easy and safe to read riding status without taking your eyes off the direction of riding. The large size Front-n-rear disc braking system can stop the e-bike within second. You can easily control headlight, switch speed mode, activate the horn by pressing corresponding button once.

Professional Service - This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled, you can finish the assembly within minutes. This E-bike has also 5 speed modes, Cruise Control and Push-assist function. We've prepared a series of tutorial videos on the product page for your reference. One-year or 180-day warranty for different parts. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact us. We're here to help you.
